schema.row_id: zero-based CSV data record index; header excluded

scope: All source rows and contradictory labels are retained locally. Group membership proves exact stored-payload isolation, not packet, flow, capture, or attack-family identity. Metadata is retained without inferring padding, true byte length, timing units, or packet ordering.

selection.unit: unique payload group within source and split

split.algorithm: SHA256(b'packet-data-split-v1\0' + ASCII(seed) + b'\0' + raw payload SHA256); first 8 bytes big-endian; thresholds floor(2**64*70/100), floor(2**64*85/100)
split.independence: exact payload identity only; physical flow/capture independence is unknown
split.membership_sha256: SHA256 of concatenated raw 32-byte payload digests in ascending order
